today_news.title: Delhi High Court hands OpenAI a win by rejecting major Indian news agency's copyright injunction
today_news.summary: The Delhi High Court has handed OpenAI a major win in its copyright fight with news agency ANI. For the first time, a court has classified AI training as private use. ANI undermined its own case by citing articles published after the models were trained. The main trial is still pending.

today_news.title: METR introduces a new metric to calculate exactly when AI agents become more expensive than humans
